tools.name: rlm.delegate

params.task: string - the sub-task for the child agent
params.allow: list of strings - tool names the child can use

tools.desc: Spawn a child agent to handle a multi-step sub-task. Use for commands that need multiple tool calls (e.g. 'set a reminder and send an email'). Returns the child's result as text.

tools.name: system.volume.set
tools.desc: Set master volume

tools.name: system.volume.mute
tools.desc: Mute/unmute toggle

tools.name: system.brightness.set
tools.desc: Set screen brightness

tools.name: app.open
tools.desc: Launch app by name (browser, terminal, spotify, files, calculator, settings...)

tools.name: app.close
tools.desc: Close app window

tools.name: screenshot.take
tools.desc: Capture screen

params.page: string e.g. wifi, bluetooth, display, sound

tools.name: browser.search
tools.desc: Web search in default browser

tools.name: time.now
tools.desc: Speak current time/date

tools.name: none
tools.desc: Normal conversation - no tool call

tools.name: timer.set
tools.desc: Set a countdown timer. e.g. 'set a timer for 15 minutes'

tools.name: alarm.set
tools.desc: Set an alarm at a specific time. e.g. 'wake me up at 7'

tools.name: reminder.set
tools.desc: Set a one-shot reminder. e.g. 'remind me to call mom in 10 minutes'

tools.name: date.now
tools.desc: Speak today's date (vs time.now which speaks the clock time)

tools.name: system.lock
tools.desc: Lock the screen (gnome-screensaver / loginctl)

tools.name: system.shutdown

params.confirm: bool, must be true. Ask the user before calling.

tools.desc: Schedule a shutdown. Requires explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: system.cancel_shutdown
tools.desc: Cancel a pending shutdown

tools.name: system.battery.status
tools.desc: Speak current battery percentage and charging state

tools.name: system.wifi.status
tools.desc: Speak current Wi-Fi connection status (SSID + on/off)

tools.name: clipboard.read
tools.desc: Speak the current clipboard contents

tools.name: clipboard.write
tools.desc: Copy text to the clipboard

tools.name: note.add
tools.desc: Append a quick note to ~/cozy_notes.md (read back with note.read)

tools.name: note.read

params.limit: int optional, default 5 (most recent N notes)

tools.desc: Speak the most recent N notes

tools.name: calc.compute
tools.desc: Evaluate a simple math expression and speak the result

tools.name: app.list_running
tools.desc: List the apps currently open

tools.name: app.switch

params.name: string, app name or window title fragment

tools.desc: Switch focus to an already-open app

notes: Router maps STT text -> LLM (Qwen3-0.6B fine-tune); LLM emits {tool, params} JSON or none. Hinglish variants welcome in training data. v2: added timer.set, alarm.set, reminder.set, date.now, system.lock, system.shutdown (confirm-gated), system.cancel_shutdown, system.battery.status, system.wifi.status, clipboard.read/write, note.add/read, calc.compute, app.list_running, app.switch.
